title: trifolium michelianum var. balansae
intro: Trifolium michelianum var. balansae, commonly known as Balansa clover, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It has been used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Balansa clover are attributed to its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may also aid in lowering blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include isoflavones, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
